H0MI03316.name: Hillary Scholten
H0MI03316.bio: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 3rd District and former Department of Justice attorney.

positions.stance: Works to lower health care and prescription drug costs, ban insurers from denying coverage for pre-existing conditions, and defend and expand the Affordable Care Act.
Believes decisions about pregnancy belong to women, not politicians; "I will always protect a woman's right to choose."
Supports lowering drug and energy costs, investing in Michigan semiconductor manufacturing, small businesses and infrastructure, and the right of workers to collectively bargain.
Wants to strengthen Michigan public schools, compensate educators fairly, and expand job training, apprenticeship and skilled trade programs.
Opposes raising the retirement age or cutting or privatizing Social Security and Medicare; supports letting Medicare negotiate drug prices.

H6MI03198.name: Terri DeBoer
H6MI03198.bio: Meteorologist and author who has worked in West Michigan for over 30 years.

positions.stance: Supports expanding health care choice and competition, Direct Primary Care, Health Savings Accounts, and price transparency to lower costs.
"Cut taxes and reduce government spending to fight inflation"; supports eliminating burdensome regulations on small businesses.
Supports an "all-of-the-above energy strategy," expanded nuclear energy, and opposes costly energy mandates that raise utility bills.
"Secure the border and enforce immigration laws"; supports removing dangerous criminals who enter illegally and reforming the asylum process.

H0MI02094.name: Bill Huizenga
H0MI02094.bio: Ottawa County small business owner serving in Congress, including on the House Financial Services Committee.

positions.stance: Has pushed for fiscal discipline to combat inflation and lower costs for energy, groceries, and housing.
Supports policies to expand American energy production and reduce dependence on foreign sources to bring down energy prices.
Has worked to remove burdensome regulations and expand access to capital so small businesses can grow and hire.
Describes himself as a consistent voice for limited government, secure borders, safe communities, and supporting law enforcement.
Focuses on accountability, financial oversight, and long-term fiscal responsibility, working across the aisle while holding to conservative principles.

H6MI04204.name: Sean McCann
H6MI04204.bio: Michigan State Senator and former City Commissioner.

positions.stance: His "number one priority" is lowering everyday costs, from utilities to prescription drugs to housing, while protecting and creating good-paying jobs.
Will fight to extend ACA tax credits, lower prescription drug costs, and strengthen access to care in rural and urban communities.
Supports solar, wind, and nuclear energy in Michigan for energy independence and jobs, rather than aging coal and natural gas plants.
Wants to protect the Great Lakes, air, and water so no one has to worry about the safety of their drinking water.
Supports free and fair elections and independent redistricting, and will fight attempts to undermine elections.

H6MI05227.name: Christian Vukasovich
H6MI05227.bio: Teacher and union organizer who worked his way through school as a bricklayer.

positions.stance: Will fight for an economy that rewards hard work, including "raising wages, protecting good union jobs, and investing in local manufacturing and infrastructure."
Will push to enforce antitrust laws and take on monopolies and special interests so companies compete fairly.
Will work for policies that build and preserve affordable homes, help first-time buyers, and ensure renters are treated fairly.
Will fight to strengthen family farms through antitrust enforcement, local food processing investment, and expanded crop insurance and disaster relief.
Will defend free speech, freedom of worship, "the right to vote, due process, and equal treatment under the law."

H4MI12079.name: Debbie Dingell
H4MI12079.bio: U.S. Representative; former General Motors executive, GM Foundation president, and Wayne State Board of Governors chair.

positions.stance: Fighting to ensure taxpayer dollars are used to lower the high cost of living, fix the broken health care system, and clean up corruption.
Believes everyone in America has a right to quality health care; co-chairs the Medicare for All Caucus and works to lower prescription drug costs.
Supports domestic manufacturing including the auto industry, renegotiating the USMCA, collective bargaining, and the PRO Act.
Seeks reforms requiring ICE to follow the same rules as other law enforcement, such as no masks, body cameras, and judicial warrants; supports comprehensive immigration reform.
Advocates protecting the Great Lakes, addressing PFAS chemicals, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and expanding clean energy that creates American jobs.

H4MI06154.name: Heather Smiley
H4MI06154.bio: Retired after more than 32 years at Ford in roles including product development, strategy and planning, and analytics.

positions.stance: "Pursue and enforce laws where violations occur, and uphold our God-given rights as the framers intended."
"Enable and support law enforcement to effectively perform their duties, enforce equal protection, and uphold natural law."
"Ensure and enforce ballot security, and secure voting only for legal U.S. citizens."
"Eliminate excessive & wasteful spending, pay off the debt and balance the budget, and ensure plan transparency."
"Protect and Increase global trade relations and ensure nothing less than bi-directional fairness."

H2MI07123.name: Tom Barrett
H2MI07123.bio: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 7th District, 22-year U.S. Army veteran, and former Michigan state legislator.

H6MI07298.name: William Lawrence
H6MI07298.bio: Community organizer from the Lansing area.

positions.stance: Supports major federal investment in housing at all price points, mixed-income housing, and a federal tenant bill of rights.
"I support Medicare for All, which would remove the profit motive from health insurance."
Supports more affordable housing, rapid rehousing, transitional and permanent supportive housing, and a "Housing First" approach.
Wants to defend existing mental health programs, opposing cuts to the VA and Community Mental Health, and invest in community and care.
Supports "a billionaire minimum tax, which is a minimum wealth tax rate that the mega-wealthy must pay."

H4MI08218.name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
H4MI08218.bio: U.S. Representative; former Michigan State Senator and Bay City Commissioner.

positions.stance: Introduced legislation banning members of Congress from trading stock; supports reversing Citizens United and expanding anti-gerrymandering practices nationwide.
Working to force drug companies to negotiate prices with Medicaid, end reckless tariffs, and stop Wall Street from buying up housing.
Fighting to let every American have the choice to buy into Medicare and wrote bipartisan legislation to make pricing more transparent.
Co-sponsors the bipartisan bill to fully fund local law enforcement and has secured federal investments for local departments.
Works with anyone regardless of party; all 19 bills she introduced in her first year have a Republican partner.

H6MI08312.name: Thomas J. Smith
H6MI08312.bio: Former General Motors employee who co-founded Jar Head Salsa in 2009.

positions.stance: "Protect the 1st and 2nd Amendment rights of every American" and stand firm against federal overreach.
Supports "finishing the wall, restoring deportations, and ending catch-and-release."
Will fight to cut wasteful spending, reduce regulations, and lower taxes so families keep more of what they earn.
Will fight to ensure veterans receive the care, benefits, and respect they deserve.
Will fight to balance the budget, cut wasteful programs, and hold government accountable.

H0MI10287.name: Lisa McClain
H0MI10287.bio: U.S. Representative since 2021; spent 30 years in the private sector, including at American Express and Hantz Financial.

positions.stance: Supports reducing taxes, rolling back regulations that stifle small business growth, and free and fair international trade policies.
"We must secure our borders, period, full stop"; supports building a wall and enforcing immigration laws to the fullest extent.
Works to protect farmers from harmful regulations, pushes for beneficial trade agreements, and wants to defend family farms from foreign ownership.
Strongly supports an individual right to own guns and opposes federal licensing of gun owners and national gun registration.
Wants to bring jobs home by investing in next-gen biofuels and regenerative materials, expanding trade schools, and protecting the right to organize.
Wants to empower family farmers with regenerative practices and break the grip of global conglomerates and monopolies on the food supply.
Supports making the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share, cutting taxes for working families, raising the minimum wage, and capping CEO pay ratios.
Will fight to break corporate healthcare monopolies and ensure affordable care "through Medicare For All"; supports expanding childcare services.
Supports American-made solar, wind, and other technologies for cheap, clean power and holding companies accountable for pollution.

H6MI10359.name: Michael Bouchard Jr.
H6MI10359.bio: U.S. Army veteran of the 82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions and member of the Michigan Army National Guard.

positions.stance: Supports protecting Michigan manufacturing, "bringing manufacturing jobs back home and cutting red tape that crushes small businesses."
Stands for "finishing the wall, restoring the 'Remain in Mexico' policy, and ending catch-and-release once and for all."
Wants schools "back to the basics" and will back a Parents' Bill of Rights.
Says families spend too much on essentials and "We need policies that look out for families and lower costs."
"I will always protect Medicare and Social Security"; wants to root out waste and fraud in those programs.

H6MI10276.name: Christina Hines
H6MI10276.bio: Prosecutor who has handled cases from district courts to the Michigan Supreme Court.

positions.stance: Will fight to lower costs, take on politicians and corporations taking advantage of working families, and fight for good-paying Michigan jobs.
Will fight for safer communities, world-class schools, and resources law enforcement needs to prevent violent crime and protect kids and seniors online.
Refuses corporate PAC money and will work to ban members of Congress from trading stocks.

H6MI11290.name: Ethan Baker
H6MI11290.bio: Mayor of Troy since 2019 and former Troy City Council member.

positions.stance: Lists a stable, affordable economy with good-paying jobs, better wages, and "inflation kept in check" as a top priority voters told him about.
Prioritizes "more manufacturing and skilled-trade jobs here in Michigan."
Supports "better access to mental healthcare and meaningful reform in physical healthcare."
Supports improved literacy, education decisions made at the local level, strong parental involvement, and a federal role supporting local districts.
Prioritizes "safety at home and abroad, so you and your family can feel secure."

H6MI11191.name: Jeremy Moss
H6MI11191.bio: Michigan State Senator and President Pro Tempore of the Michigan Senate.

positions.stance: Supports lowering prescription drug costs and premiums and "a robust public option as a pathway to universal coverage."
Supports federal investment in affordable housing, expanded pre-K and Head Start, stopping chaotic tariff policy, and cracking down on price gouging.
Says ICE "must be dismantled" under the current administration; supports pathways to citizenship for DACA recipients and long-standing undocumented immigrants.
Will fight to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, defeat the SAVE Act, and stop federalization of elections.
Supports a total ban on members of Congress, staff, and the administration trading individual stocks or using prediction markets.

H8MI13250.name: Rashida Tlaib
H8MI13250.bio: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 12th District and former immigration lawyer.

positions.stance: Supports a near-universal basic income, affordable housing, workers' rights, and canceling medical, utility, and student debt.
Supports ending mass incarceration and detention and is "advocating to abolish and defund ICE."
Fighting for "the human right to water," clean air, and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Believes "healthcare is a human right"; pushing for reproductive justice and to end medical debt.
Supports expanding protections for women and LGBTQI+ people, universal childcare, equal pay, and the right to access abortion care.

H2MI12198.name: James D. Hooper
H2MI12198.bio: Detroit native who worked in Eastern Market and the building trades and served overseas with Samaritan's Purse.

positions.stance: "I am Pro-Life from conception to natural death."
"The 2nd Amendment is non-negotiable"; describes it as the essential bulwark guaranteeing all other rights.
Supports parental rights in education and advocates "the swift reduction and rapid elimination of the Federal Department of Education."
Supports holistic and preventive care, including mental health, through a free-market approach, and opposes required medical treatments or vaccine passports.
Wants to reduce "overburdensome regulations and bureaucracy" to promote American jobs for American workers.

H6MI13254.name: Donavan McKinney
H6MI13254.bio: Michigan State Representative and former member of SEIU Healthcare Michigan.

positions.stance: Fighting for every worker's right to form a union and earn a living wage, funded partly by raising taxes on billionaires and corporations.
Supports a Green New Deal "transitioning to 100% clean and renewable energy" to create green union jobs and clean the air and water.
Wants to get big money out of politics, citing the Citizens United decision and corporate and Super PAC spending.
Supports higher teacher pay, universal free school lunch and pre-K, tuition-free public colleges and trade schools, and canceling student loan debt.
Supports Medicare for All and a national homes guarantee, plus tenant protections including nationwide rent control.
Believes Congress should work with the President to remove marijuana from the federal list of controlled substances and modernize federal law.
Will introduce legislation to substantially reform qualified immunity for federal officers, including Border Patrol and ICE, who knowingly violate constitutional rights.
Will advocate oversight and investigations into U.S. funds and materials provided for foreign conflicts, including Ukraine, with stronger auditing requirements.
Will fight to protect Medicare and Medicaid while eliminating fraud, waste, and abuse, and supports lower prescription drug costs through competition.
Committed to strengthening the VA through oversight and reforms, reducing disability claim delays, and expanding PTSD and traumatic brain injury treatment.

H4NJ01084.name: Donald Norcross
H4NJ01084.bio: Electrician by trade who completed a skilled apprenticeship program and a community college degree.

positions.stance: Supports lowering prescription drug costs, Medicare drug price negotiation, protecting pre-existing condition protections, and "reproductive freedom for all women."
Supports public schools, more affordable child care, expanded Pre-K, and affordable, accessible higher education.
Supports police, firefighters and first responders and was an early supporter of equipping law enforcement with body cameras.
"I support raising wages, growing jobs in high-skilled industries, and ensuring fair pay and safe workplaces for all."
Prioritizes bringing back American manufacturing, a Buy American provision, infrastructure investment, and registered apprenticeship programs.

H2NJ01187.name: Damon Galdo
H2NJ01187.bio: Tradesman who has worked in construction and founded Americas Pulse Network and the Jersey Sure podcast.

positions.stance: Priorities are to "reduce unnecessary federal spending," support affordable American energy, encourage economic growth, and cut burdensome regulations.
Supports secure borders, enforcing existing immigration laws, and stronger cooperation between federal and local law enforcement.
Will require proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections and voter identification, improve voter roll accuracy, and strengthen mail-in ballot security.
Supports greater school transparency, parental access to curriculum, and a return to reading, writing, mathematics, science, history, and civics.
Will support expanding apprenticeships, strengthening vocational education, workforce development, and making homeownership more attainable.
"I will never support cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, or Social Security that are not specifically aimed at reducing waste, fraud, or abuse."
Sponsored legislation to eliminate federal income taxes on seniors' Social Security income.
"Fully supports and recently voted to make the Trump tax cuts PERMANENT."
Supports the federal tax deduction on overtime pay so workers can take home more of their overtime earnings.
Supports letting tipped workers earning under $150,000 avoid federal income taxes on their first $25,000 in tips.

H6NJ02251.name: Zack Mullock
H6NJ02251.bio: Two-term Mayor of Cape May and small business owner.

positions.stance: Calls for "a fair tax system that holds corporations and the wealthiest accountable" and supports small businesses and consumers.
Supports "Medicare for All funded by fairer corporate taxes and a fair tax on the top 5%" and expanded Medicare drug price negotiation.
Would ban institutional investors from bulk-buying single-family homes and increase federal funding for affordable housing in South Jersey.
Supports large-scale solar, federal investment in renewables and coastal resiliency, and stricter Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act enforcement.
Advocates diplomacy and human rights, fully funding U.S. contributions to NATO and the UN, and strengthening relationships with democratic allies.

H4NJ03080.name: Herb Conaway
H4NJ03080.bio: Physician, U.S. Air Force veteran, and former New Jersey State Assembly member serving in Congress.

positions.stance: Advocates expanding the Child Tax Credit and the SALT deduction and supports the "Shrinkflation Reduction Act of 2024."
Says it is of utmost importance to "codify Roe v. Wade into national law" and supports the Right to Contraception Act.
Supports the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to strengthen and restore sections of the Voting Rights Act of 1965.
Will support efforts to take New Jersey's caps on co-pays for life-saving drugs like insulin, inhalers, and epinephrine to the national level.
Has introduced state legislation on invasive species and zero-emission lawn equipment and endorses policies "aimed at making us more environmentally secure."

H6NJ03184.name: Michael McGuire
H6NJ03184.bio: U.S. Marine Corps veteran who has served twice and is currently in the Naval Reserve.

positions.stance: "My top priority is restoring affordability and economic security for working families," starting with cutting wasteful government spending and lowering taxes on working families.
Supports term limits for Members of Congress to restore accountability and rebuild trust in government.
Supports funding military readiness, training, and modernization, and fixing VA systems to deliver quality healthcare, including mental health services, for veterans.

H8NJ04014.name: Chris Smith
H8NJ04014.bio: U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 4th Congressional District for forty-six years.

positions.stance: Believes in recognizing "healthcare as a right, not a privilege" and building a guaranteed healthcare system.
Supports guaranteed paid family leave, with every parent eligible for 12 weeks of paid leave after having a child.
Supports "guaranteed preschool beginning at age 3" for everyone who wants it.
Will work to tackle rising insurance costs, invest in coastal resilience for shore towns, and make polluters pay; opposes gutting the National Flood Insurance Program.
Will fight for ecologically and aesthetically responsible offshore wind investments and explore new hydroelectric infrastructure.
